Party Saves Highreach from Duplirat Crisis

The party returned from the mines to find Highreach in chaos — fires, sewer rats, and looters overrunning the city.

  • Helped put out fires across multiple districts
  • Closed broken sewer grates to stop the rat swarms
  • Fought off looters and duplirats in the streets
  • Escorted civilians to safety
  • The city was saved thanks to the party's combined efforts
